title: Chapter 1052
paragraphs: Chapter 1052
Episode 251. The Great Adversaries (2)
Orgal's pupils dilated.
[...What did you say?]

He leaned in close to the record window, as if to bury his face in it. Though not an expert in record magic, he intuitively felt that this record window was different. An inexplicable sense of alienation pierced his entire body.
[Why are you only telling me this now!?]
"It's understandable, but stop talking nonsense. Why would I have any reason to tell you this? We were enemies."

Of course, she had already shown this record window to her comrades, but without any particular context or clues, it wasn't something that required intensive analysis. Above all, after the liberation of Lafrarosa, Valeria had to monitor the enemy's movements daily, leaving her no time.

"Anyway, if there really are multiple worlds, parallel dimensions, and if their inception was Zipple's historical manipulation, then the Hister family must have always been Zipple's biggest headache."
Hister.
In some ways, Zipple feared that name even more than Runcandel's. It was a family that could directly counter their weapon of 'history manipulation'.

"According to your memories, the history of these multiple worlds always had major similarities. Mostly you played a kind of savior role, with only Jin and I absent. Then my ancestors and I must have always opposed Zipple, never collaborating with you. And this record window, it must be one of the results of that."
Orgal met Valeria's gaze, trembling.
-Solderet always chose Temar. Just as I've chosen you now. Moreover, his power is not greater than mine. It seems unlikely that he knew something I didn't.
-But if there was help from someone else, he might have recognized the diverged worlds before me.
He recalled what Helluram had said.

In his mind, the accumulated memories of the multiple worlds felt like exploding all at once. It was possible that Valeria never appeared in those worlds simply because he had never encountered her. Valeria was always operating beyond his scope of awareness.
'But why? I have always been Zipple's greatest adversary. If in every world Valeria's goal was to eliminate Zipple, why didn't she reach out to me?'
Maybe, just as Heluram always chose him, and Solderet always chose Temar.
Perhaps Valeria always chose Jin.

For a moment, such a thought crossed Orgal's mind. But any thought eventually led back to the question: why? There was no apparent reason why Valeria would choose only Jin Runcandel. In those worlds, he had always been the best adversary.
[My head... It's dizzy. Then what's the reason the other Valerias didn't join hands with me?]

"Those Valerias are me but not me. But if I had to guess, I was always in hiding. I might have been discovered and eliminated by Zipple while trying to contact you, or my family might have been completely crushed before I was born. Or perhaps they simply didn't trust you."

Orgal didn't have a complete grasp of all the histories of the multiple worlds. Naturally, what he remembered were only the experiences of 'other world Orgals', and even those memories were not always clear.
[That could be... ]
"Orgal. The important thing now is that Zipple might not be the only one who can interfere with other dimensions."
Helluram had said that the Magic Tower was supporting this world's Zipple through some method. The result was the recent exponential advancement of the origin stone technology.
However, if Valeria's hypothesis was correct, then beings from other dimensions influencing this world weren't limited to the Magic Tower.
"I'm curious about when the other-dimensional Valeria enabled me to see this record window."
[The timing?]

"I mean, I'm wondering if this message was sent while observing me in real-time from another dimension or if it was sent after learning about the future of other dimensions through record magic. It seems more like the former. If they knew the future of this world, they wouldn't have written in the record window as if congratulating me."

The pinnacle of record magic isn't just revealing all past events but also accessing future records. However, that future isn't fixed like Az Mill's, and the outcome changes based on the choices of those who view the records.
As far as Valeria knew, there was no Hister capable of perfectly mastering that realm.

Among the Hister ancestors she found in the family records, none could freely access 'future records'. According to the records, the Histers considered those rare moments when they glimpsed future records as blessings or revelations.
Valeria had also experienced such moments of blessing.
The moment in 1795 when Jin, as a mid-level cadet, first sought Valeria during a mission in Mamit, and the moment in 1799 when Jin and Valeria met in Mamit.
Valeria knew all of these in advance through the future records confirmed in the family records.
'Then could that dream also have been a message from me from another world?'
Suddenly, Valeria recalled the prophetic dream she had most frequently during her teenage years.
Are you going to keep lying there like that?
Get lost.
Pathetic, really. Your proud brothers would be ashamed, Jin.
What? How do you know my name?
Seeing that you're still curious, you must still have some attachment to this world. Follow me, I'll forgive you for once aiming your blade at someone who extended their hand to help.

It was only after the Holy Kingdom incident, when Jin's true identity was exposed to the world, that Valeria realized the protagonist of her dream was Jin. That's why she immediately called his name in a familiar manner when they met in Mamit.
Soon, Valeria's thoughts drifted to the memories of Honka Island. She remembered the day she walked along the beach with Jin, discussing the Hister lineage's legacy, Maliet Hister.
At that time, Valeria confessed to Jin about her prophetic dreams and future records, saying:

-I always thought those dreams and future records were the arrangements and destinies left by my ancestors. Probably in the future records seen by my ancestors, there was content indicating that I needed you to fulfill my mission.
'Maybe it wasn't the ancestors who arranged everything after seeing Jin's records, but... maybe it was me from another world.'
The dream, the future records, and even the record revealing 'Jin's death,' might all have been informed by Valeria from another dimension.
She couldn't easily sort out her thoughts.
However, one fact became increasingly clear: the Histers and Valeria had chosen only Jin Runcandel as the key to defeat the great evil, Zipple.
Valeria's gaze naturally fell on Jin.
Jin looked guilty.
In reality, after hearing the truth of the multiverse, he was overwhelmed with the sense of debt as a regressor.
He wondered if in those worlds, he hadn't lived like a recluse after meeting Valeria. That he hadn't fought alongside Orgal, and Valeria couldn't play an active role like now.
Then Valeria, suddenly and steadily, walked up to him.
Orgal and the others, already confused by the complex truth, were startled and watched her. Valeria quickly stood face-to-face with Jin, who looked surprised.
"Hey, what's with her? Hey! Redhead! Won't you back off? My head's about to explode as it is."
"Jin."
"Huh?"

"I lived turning my back on the world since my teens, solely driven by my Hister mission. Then I met you, chose you, and entered your world. Thanks to you, I've changed enough to accept even annoying and noisy people like Sandra as comrades."
[...What's this, suddenly getting interesting. Amidst the terrible truth of the world, is this love now?]
Orgal was nudged by Luna, and Hedo covered Sandra's mouth as she was about to curse.

"And all the Valerias definitely chose you. They didn't regret choosing you. Even if those numerous worlds perished or were subjugated by Zipple, the Valerias from other worlds never once felt disappointed in you."
Of course, Valeria had never seen such records.
But she was sure. She knew her own heart, even without record magic.
"Maybe this world too will eventually meet such an end. But even then, I'll still think the same. Being with you was the best decision in all my lives."
[Wow, if this isn't a public confession, then what is, up, up.]
"Shut up, Orgal. It's an important moment."
"Up up up up up up Hedo, let me go! I'm dying! Up!"
Everyone except Sandra was secretly thrilled by Valeria's sudden words. Especially Enya, whose face turned red as she continuously rolled her eyes.
'Oh my, what a windfall! What will you do, Lord Jin! How will you respond!'
Everyone was eagerly awaiting Jin's response, just like Enya.
However, Valeria herself didn't intend her words to elicit a response.
"So don't make that face. We haven't lost in this world yet, right? I'll go get some air to clear my head. It seems I've heard all the important stories from Orgal anyway."
Valeria gracefully left her seat.
"No! Lord Jin, are you just going to stand there? Follow her! As the president of your fan club, I'm very disappointed in your attitude!"
"Well, our kid hasn't had a romance, right? At times like this, just shut up and stay still. Ah, you don't like history buffs, do you? Not your type?"
"Upp up up! Up up!"
Jin, feeling dizzy, looked at his companions.
"Everyone, calm down. It's because of you, not me, that Valeria feels embarrassed. Let's finish the meeting first."
translator_notes: Note: upp up up up - sound someone makes when trying to speak while gagged
